itemized.notes: 8 pages: p1 cover, p2 Summary Page, p3 'Itemized Contributions Received' FORM ('See attached' handwritten, all cells otherwise empty), p4 the contributions ATTACHMENT (LANDSCAPE, born-digital), p5 'Itemized Expenditures Made' FORM ('See attached'), p6+p7 the expenditures ATTACHMENT (PORTRAIT, born-digital, 2 pages), p8 BLANK. THE ATTACHMENTS PRINT NO YEAR ON ANY DATE ('17-Jun', '3-Jul' ...), so EVERY date field on both sides is left blank with needs_review=1 and the verbatim day-month kept in the row note - the report period (Sept 15, 2014 interim) was deliberately NOT used to fill them. The p4 contributions attachment has a black-box county redaction over the mailing-address column only; its City / State / Zip columns are outside the box and legible, so donor_city/donor_state ARE populated (state printed as the full word 'Utah', or 'ID' for two out-of-state donors; zip not recorded). The p4 attachment prints no column headers - the columns were identified by content and position (date, name, amount, occupation, [redacted address], city, state, zip) and the whole-column sum matches the stated total exactly, so the column assignment is confirmed by reconciliation as well as by inspection. FIELD-SHIFT SCREEN: 24 names / 24 amounts / 24 city-state groups on p4; 47 and 11 name-purpose-amount triples on p6/p7 - no shift detected on either side.
